'''Dreeva''' was an individual who lived on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], specifically on the [[Minboosa District]]. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a [[Rebellion in the Minboosa District|rebellion]] at the refinery's main level.<ref name="ThePathBelow" />
